model: AXIS S2224 Mk II Rack Appliance
aliases: AXIS Camera Station S2224 Mk II Appliance
series: AXIS Camera Station S22 Appliance Series

video.decoding_capability: Windows client live view: 1 stream x 4K at 30 fps; 4 split x 1080p at 30 fps; 9 split x 720p at 30 fps; 16, 25 and 36 split x 360p at 15 fps; 1 stream x 8K at 20 fps. Web client: 1 stream x 8K at 30 fps

storage.built_in: 12 TB (2x6 TB) Surveillance Class HDD; 256 GB SSD operating system drive

power.supply: Max 520 W, 260 W PoE dedicated; 100–240 V AC, 6.5–2.5 A, 50/60 Hz

features: 24 AXIS Camera Station Pro Core Device NVR licenses and 10 AXIS Audio Manager Pro licenses included
All-in-one appliance with integrated PoE switch: 24x PoE RJ45 1 Gbps, 1x SFP 1 Gbps, 1x RJ45 1 Gbps (switch), 1x RJ45 1 Gbps (server)
Qualified for up to 24 video channels and 48 doors
Can be scaled with more devices when using AXIS S30 Recorder Series
Qualified for 200 simultaneous audio streams using AXIS Audio Manager Pro
Qualified for up to 1,000 doors with access control only
Supports AI applications such as Smart Search 2
FIPS 140-2 level 2 certified Trusted Platform Module (TPM 2.0)
notes: Datasheet gives power consumption, excluding connected devices, of 110 W typical and 130 W maximum.
